reels.recommendation_summary: Highway 279 (Potash Road) scenic byway along the Colorado River out of Moab: #1 petroglyph panel, #2 Poison Spider dinosaur tracks, #3 Wall Street climbing walls, #4 Corona Arch, #5 Jug Handle Arch, #6 the blue Potash Ponds — with the byway itself gaining this as a second source.

reels.creator: @braden_vanham
reels.recommendation_summary: A Michigan fall itinerary of waterfalls (plus one bridge): Chapel Falls and Miners Falls in Pictured Rocks, Kitch-iti-kipi spring, Wagner Falls near Munising, and the SkyBridge at Boyne Mountain over a valley of fall colors.

reels.title: Mt. Monadnock in New Hampshire
reels.creator: @calvin_on_the_internet
reels.recommendation_summary: Mount Monadnock in Jaffrey, New Hampshire — the iconic 3,165-ft solitary peak in Monadnock State Park, climbed via the White Dot Trail to a bare summit with six-state views on clear days.

reels.title: Known as the '8th Wonder of the World' — Burney Falls
reels.creator: @wanderlusttravelcouple
reels.creator_name: Nick Kokenos & Erica Battle | Adventure Travel
reels.recommendation_summary: Burney Falls in McArthur-Burney Falls Memorial State Park, California — a 129-ft spring-fed waterfall flowing ~100M gallons a day, year-round, a short walk from parking; summer weekends need reservations.

reels.title: An underground waterfall inside Lookout Mountain: Ruby Falls
reels.creator: @wanderlusttravelcouple
reels.creator_name: Nick Kokenos & Erica Battle | Adventure Travel
reels.recommendation_summary: Ruby Falls in Chattanooga, Tennessee — the underground waterfall deep inside Lookout Mountain, reached by elevator and a guided cave walk; added as a second source on the existing pin.

reels.title: 12 bucket-list hikes NOT in national parks
reels.creator: @theadventurepostcard
reels.recommendation_summary: A ranked countdown of 12 bucket-list hikes that are NOT in national parks, from The Wave (#1) to Cathedral Rock (#12): The Wave, Colchuck Lake, Kasha-Katuwe Tent Rocks, Hanging Lake, Ice Lake Basin, Bisti Wings, Blue Lakes, Sawtooth Lake, Awa'awapuhi, Cathedral Spires, Havasu Falls and Cathedral Rock.

reels.title: Sunrise hike at Guadalupe Peak, the highest point in Texas
reels.creator: @serg.goes
reels.recommendation_summary: A sunrise hike up Guadalupe Peak in Guadalupe Mountains National Park — the highest point in Texas; added as an additional source on the existing pin.

reels.creator: @tedsalwaystraveling
reels.creator_name: Ted Mureiko | Solo Traveler and Photographer

reels.title: Trail of Ten Falls at Silver Falls State Park — walk under 4 of them
reels.creator: @thetravelingdans
reels.creator_name: DANNY & DANIE | travel | hiking | road trips
reels.recommendation_summary: The Trail of Ten Falls at Silver Falls State Park, Oregon — a 7.7-mile loop past ten waterfalls, walking behind four of them; go clockwise from the South Falls lot, $5 parking, no dogs on this trail.

reels.title: 2 incredible viewpoints, 1 short hike: Heart Lake Trail from Castle Lake

reels.creator_name: Nick Kokenos & Erica Battle | Adventure Travel
reels.recommendation_summary: The Heart Lake Trail from Castle Lake near Mount Shasta, California — a 3-mile out-and-back with ~800 ft of gain and two standout Mount Shasta viewpoints.

reels.creator_name: Ted Mureiko | Solo Traveler and Photographer

reels.title: Catawba Falls, North Carolina — a hidden gem in the Blue Ridge Mountains

reels.title: Marshall's Beach — San Francisco's most underrated Golden Gate view
reels.creator: @gabbettfamilytravels
reels.recommendation_summary: Marshall's Beach in San Francisco — a crowd-free Golden Gate Bridge viewpoint reached from the Langdon Court lot via Battery West and the Batteries to Bluffs Trail; avoid high tide.

reels.title: Devil's Den, Florida — swim inside the earth for $30 (American Bucket List ep. 1)
reels.creator: @showmelovejete

reels.title: Royal Gorge Route Railroad — insane canyon views, no hiking required
reels.creator: @mccrawsonthemap
reels.creator_name: Melissa McCraw and Carson McCraw | RV Life | US Travel
reels.recommendation_summary: The Royal Gorge Route Railroad from Cañon City, CO — a ~2-hour scenic ride through the 1,000-ft Royal Gorge under the Royal Gorge Bridge, no hiking required.

reels.recommendation_summary: Vesper Peak off the Mountain Loop Highway, Washington — a steep ~6.5-mile, 4,120-ft climb past Vesper Lake to a sunset summit; headlamp for the descent, Northwest Forest Pass at the trailhead.

reels.title: 9 Bay Area Hikes You Don't Want to Miss

reels.title: Snow Lake — a stunning alpine lake just 45 min from Seattle

reels.recommendation_summary: Snow Lake at Snoqualmie Pass, Washington — a 7.2-mile round trip to turquoise alpine water, 45 min from Seattle, extensible to Gem Lake; added as an additional source on the existing pin.

reels.title: Would you stay the night in this cave? Beckham Creek Cave Lodge

reels.creator_name: Nick Kokenos & Erica Battle | Adventure Travel

reels.title: Cascades Falls, Pembroke Virginia — one of the best hikes in Virginia

reels.title: Best wildlife viewing in the USA

reels.recommendation_summary: The best wildlife viewing in the USA is in Alaska: Katmai (2,000+ brown bears in summer), Kenai Fjords (puffins, sea otters, orcas, eagles, humpbacks, sea lions), Lake Clark (brown bears), Glacier Bay (the marine list plus bears and mountain goats) and Denali (moose, grizzlies, Dall sheep, caribou, wolves). All five parks were already pinned, so the post is attached to each as a source.

reels.title: Talk about a tropical adventure paradise — the Azores

Park-level only; no pins.

reels.title: Virginia in the fall — Shenandoah Valley & Shenandoah National Park

Nine new pins added.

reels.recommendation_summary: Their favorite photo spots across the parks: Grand Teton sunrise (Schwabacher Landing, Mormon Row), Bryce sunrise (Inspiration Point, Navajo Loop), Glacier (Going-to-the-Sun Road, Highline, Garden Wall, Grinnell Glacier), Rainier sunrise (Fremont Lookout, then Burroughs), White Sands Backcountry at golden hour, Capitol Reef's Cathedral Valley, Badlands golden hour (Hay Butte), Yosemite's Glacier Point in early light, Death Valley (Mesquite Flat sunrise, Zabriskie sunset), Hoh Rainforest early (Hall of Mosses), Shenandoah (Bearfence sunrise, Hawksbill sunset), Grand Canyon (South Kaibab sunrise, Hopi Point sunset), Lassen's Volcanic Scenic Byway stops — plus Hurricane Ridge at sunset (no pin). Five new pins added; attached as a source on 22 places.

reels.title: 7 National Parks, 1 epic road trip — the Southwest
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Seven national parks, one epic Southwest road trip: Grand Canyon, Arches, Canyonlands, Capitol Reef, Bryce, Zion and Great Basin. Their advice: at least 14 days (September best, May also good); a 10-day version skips Great Basin and a day from Capitol Reef; the Utah Mighty 5 alone fits in one week. Named highlights attached: Delicate Arch and Angels Landing. No new pins.

reels.title: California is so much more than Los Angeles
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: 'California is so much more than Los Angeles' — wild California beyond the cities: Mobius Arch, Point Reyes, the Coachella Valley Preserve palm oasis, Lassen's Cinder Cone (Mount Shasta in the distance), Burney Falls, Zabriskie Point, Potato Harbor, Pinnacles, Zumwalt Meadow, the Congress Trail, McWay Falls and Fern Canyon. Three new pins added.

reels.title: Rating the 11 national parks we visited in 2026 (so far)
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Rating the 11 national parks they visited in 2026 (so far): Yosemite 10/10, Kings Canyon 9/10, Lassen Volcanic 9/10, Sequoia 8/10, Saguaro 8/10, Redwoods 8/10, Everglades 7/10, Great Smoky Mountains 7/10, Biscayne 7/10, Petrified Forest 6/10, Pinnacles 6/10. (Yosemite is also where they celebrated their 6-year anniversary.) Park-level only; no pins.

Attached as a source on all 12; no new pins.

reels.recommendation_summary: Bucket-list hikes for mountain lovers: Burroughs Mountain, Great Basin's Alpine Lakes/Bristlecone/Glacier Loop, Delta Lake, Taft Point, Grinnell Glacier, Sahale Arm and Rainier's Skyline Loop. Their note: many of these high-elevation hikes are only doable July-September. Attached as a source on all seven; no new pins.

reels.title: National parks you could spend a whole week at
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: National parks you could spend a whole week at: Big Bend, Grand Teton, Rocky Mountain, Yosemite, Olympic, Yellowstone, Mount Rainier, Death Valley, Glacier, Zion, Shenandoah and North Cascades. Park-level only; no pins.

reels.title: Biking with alligators at Shark Valley
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Biking with alligators at Shark Valley: the 15-mile loop to the observation tower (2-3 hours, bike rentals or tram at the visitor center) where they counted over 100 alligators, an hour from Miami. Both places were already pinned, so the post is attached to each as a source.

reels.title: Can we just move here? — Sedona
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: A love letter to Sedona — after Page and Moab, it has 'officially taken the cake' as their all-time favorite Southwest town, where people casually run errands with red-rock views. Attached as a source on the existing Sedona pin.

reels.title: Underrated and diverse national parks
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Their underrated-and-diverse national parks list after 55 parks: Kenai Fjords, White Sands, Big Bend, Great Basin, Capitol Reef, Dry Tortugas, Badlands, Katmai, Crater Lake, Black Canyon of the Gunnison, North Cascades, Kings Canyon, Saguro and Wrangell-St. Elias. Park-level only; no pins or sources.

reels.title: Mammoth Cave — the world's longest cave system
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: A Mammoth Cave mini guide: 426 surveyed miles of the world's longest cave system (maybe 560), 54°F inside, tours on Central Time. Favorite ranger tours: Domes & Dripstones and the Historic Tour, reserved ahead. Above ground, their favorite hike — the Dixon Cave, Green River Bluffs & River Styx Spring loop — is added as a new pin, and the post is attached to the existing park pin.

reels.title: Seward, Alaska — the cutest harbor town
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Seward, 'the cutest harbor town in Alaska': a full-day Kenai Fjords boat tour, the waterfront and harbor, the Alaska SeaLife Center, Ray's Waterfront or Chinooks for dinner, the Harding Icefield Trail and a fishing charter. Attached as a source on both existing pins.

reels.title: Our favorite Alaska experiences
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Their favorite Alaska experiences after nearly two weeks in the state's parks: bear viewing at Katmai, wildlife and tidewater glaciers in Kenai Fjords, flightseeing in Wrangell-St. Elias, hiking the Harding Icefield Trail, paddleboarding on the Knik Glacier and flying next to Denali. Attached as a source on all six (the Knik Glacier pin's primary source is their dedicated paddleboarding reel).

reels.title: Our favorite Southwest town — Sedona
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Their favorite Southwest town is Sedona, 'seriously a hikers dream': favorite hikes Cathedral Rock, the Bell Rock and Courthouse Butte loop, Devil's Bridge, Seven Sacred Pools and Doe Mountain, plus mountain biking, jeep tours, scenic drives and ballooning. Four new pins added (Bell Rock, Devil's Bridge, Seven Sacred Pools, Doe Mountain); the post is also attached to the Sedona and Cathedral Rock pins.

reels.title: The ultimate Southwest road trip
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: The ultimate Southwest road trip, flying in and out of Las Vegas: Grand Canyon (South Kaibab and Bright Angel hikes; Hopi, Yaki, Powell, Moran, Pima, Maricopa and Mather Points and the Desert View Watchtower), Page (Horseshoe Bend, Antelope Canyon, Lake Powell, Wahweap), Bryce (Navajo Loop & Queen's Garden, Fairyland Loop, Mossy Cave; Inspiration, Sunset and Sunrise Points), Capitol Reef (Hickman Bridge, Grand Wash with Cassidy Arch, Panorama Point, Cathedral Valley), Hanksville (Factory Butte, Moonscape Overlook, Bentonite Hills — high-clearance 4WD) and Zion (Angels Landing, the Narrows, Canyon Overlook, and the Zion-Mount Carmel Highway drive). Eleven new pins added; the post is attached as a source on twenty more.

reels.title: A black bear crashed our Zumwalt Meadow walk
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.theme: Kings Canyon bear encounter and bear safety
reels.recommendation_summary: A black bear crashed their evening walk at Zumwalt Meadow in Kings Canyon, crossing the suspension bridge toward them — the setup for their bear-safety guide: make noise, stay alert, keep distance, never run, speak calmly, protect food, and carry bear spray where legal (not in Kings Canyon). Attached as a source on the existing Zumwalt Meadows pin.

reels.title: The tallest trees in the world — Grove of Titans
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: The Grove of Titans in Redwoods National & State Parks: 'the tallest trees in the world live up to the hype' — the parks protect nearly half the world's remaining old-growth coastal redwoods, some 370+ feet tall and 2,000+ years old. Attached as a source on the existing pin.

reels.title: 3 national parks, 1 epic road trip — the Dakotas
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.theme: Dakotas road trip — Theodore Roosevelt, Badlands, Wind Cave
reels.recommendation_summary: Three national parks, one epic Dakotas road trip: Theodore Roosevelt (South Unit — prairie dog towns, Wind Canyon at sunset, Boicourt, Buck Hill, Painted Canyon; North Unit — Oxbow, River Bend, Caprock Coulee), Badlands (overlooks Big Badlands, White River Valley, Bigfoot Pass, Panorama Point, Burns Basin, Pinnacles, Hay Butte; hikes Door, Window, Notch, Cliff Shelf, Saddle Pass), Mount Rushmore (arrive early for the morning glow), Custer State Park (Wildlife Loop Road and Needles Highway drives, Sylvan Lake, Cathedral Spires) and Wind Cave (cave tours plus the Rankin Ridge hike). Twenty-one new pins added; the post is attached as a source on eight more. Go before sunset or after sunrise for wildlife — bison, pronghorn, prairie dogs, bighorn sheep, even a rattlesnake from a distance.

reels.title: Colchuck Lake — all other hikes are ruined
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Their Colchuck Lake guide — the hike that ruined all other hikes: 9.1 miles round trip, hard, 2,352 feet of gain from the Stuart Lake Trailhead, to the clearest swimmable alpine lake under Dragontail Peak. Go late July-October, arrive early on a weekday, bring the swimsuit. Attached as a source on the existing pin.

reels.title: Wrangell-St. Elias — a national park nobody tells you about
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Wrangell-St. Elias, the national park nobody tells you about — larger than Switzerland, less than 1% road-accessible, so see it by flightseeing tour. McCarthy Road is 60 unpaved miles (many rental companies forbid it); best mid-June to early September; allow 2-5 days for Kennecott Mines, Root Glacier and the flying. Attached as a source on both existing pins.

reels.title: 4 national parks, 1 epic road trip — California
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Four national parks, one epic California road trip, in and out of San Francisco: Yosemite (Glacier Point, Vernal Falls, Lower Yosemite Falls, Cooks Meadow, Taft Point, Sentinel Dome, Tunnel View and Artist Point, Illilouette Falls), Kings Canyon (Zumwalt Meadow, the Scenic Byway, Grizzly Falls, General Grant Tree, Roaring River Falls, Mist Falls), Sequoia (Congress Trail, Big Trees Trail, Moro Rock, Tokopah Falls), Pinnacles (High Peaks, Balconies, Bear Gulch Reservoir) and Big Sur (McWay Falls, Pfeiffer Beach, Bixby Bridge, Point Lobos). Attached as a source on all eighteen pinned stops (the falls and reservoir stops without pins are named here only).

reels.title: Angels Landing — one of the most dangerous hikes in the US
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Their Angels Landing guide — 'one of the most dangerous hikes in the US,' and Carl didn't love it: 5 miles round trip, 1,827 feet, from the Grotto stop, with a permit lottery required past Scout Lookout. Skip it in bad weather or with a fear of heights; go late afternoon on an off-season weekday for calm, and make the last shuttle. Attached as a source on both existing pins.

reels.title: Bucket list USA roads
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: A 'Bucket list USA roads' montage — sweeping scenic-road footage (a Glacier overlook, a Zion tunnel, the Pacific Coast Highway, Rainier, the Rushmore approach, the Linn Cove Viaduct among them) with no roads or places named. No pins or sources.

reels.title: 4 national parks within 5 hours — New Mexico & Texas
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.theme: New Mexico & Texas national parks road trip
reels.recommendation_summary: Four national parks within five hours of each other — the New Mexico & Texas road trip: White Sands (Alkali Flat, Backcountry Camping Trail, Interdune Boardwalk, Dune Life Nature Trail; sledding and sunset), Carlsbad Caverns (Natural Entrance Trail, Big Room tour, Kings Palace ranger tour), Guadalupe Mountains (McKittrick Canyon, Devils Hall, Guadalupe Peak, El Capitan viewpoints, sunset at Salt Basin Dunes) and Big Bend (Santa Elena Canyon, Lost Mine Trail, Balanced Rock; canoe the canyon). Ten new pins added; the post is attached as a source on eight more.

reels.title: South Kaibab to Cedar Ridge — one thing you have to do in the Grand Canyon
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: One thing you have to do in the Grand Canyon: hike South Kaibab to Cedar Ridge — 3.5 miles round trip, about 1,200 feet, with Ooh Aah Point and Skeleton Point as shorter and longer options. Shuttle-only trailhead access; start early; the way back up is all uphill in the sun. Attached as a source on the existing trail pin.

reels.title: 55 down, 9 to go
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: A '55 down, 9 to go' montage — the couple posing at national park entrance signs across the country to promote their free US National Park Checklist. Park-level only; no pins or sources.

reels.title: Our favorite stay near New River Gorge — Hill Hall Hotel
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.theme: Fayetteville WV lodging — Hill Hall Hotel
reels.recommendation_summary: Their favorite stay near New River Gorge: the Hill Hall Hotel in Fayetteville, 7 minutes from the Canyon Rim Visitor Center — the town's former high school and middle school reborn as a boutique hotel, with Patsy's restaurant and bar, a courtyard fire pit, a cozy lounge and a 24-hour pantry. Added as a new pin.

reels.title: Channel Islands mini guide
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: A Channel Islands mini guide — California's least-visited national park, an hour from LA: five islands by ferry from Ventura or Oxnard, with dolphins and whales en route. They did Anacapa and Santa Cruz over two days (the year-round ferries) and recommend both: on Santa Cruz, a sea cave kayaking tour, the 5.2-mile Potato Harbor Trail and island foxes by the campground; on Anacapa, Inspiration Point via the 2.5-mile East Anacapa Island Trail — with a May-July warning for the 10,000 nesting gulls. One new pin (Inspiration Point); the post is attached to the park, Potato Harbor and Santa Cruz pins.

reels.title: NRocks via ferrata — an East Coast bucket list adventure
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: The NRocks via ferrata at Circleville, WV — an East Coast bucket-list adventure: one of the only via ferratas on the East Coast and the longest east of the Mississippi, over 1,000 feet of climbing on cables and rungs across twin sandstone fins and a suspension bridge. Added as a new pin.

reels.title: New River Gorge — one of the wildest national parks
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: New River Gorge, 'one of the wildest national parks we've visited': BASE jumping on Bridge Day, nearly 100 miles of trails (their favorites: Long Point, Endless Wall, Kaymoor Miners), the Bridge Walk catwalk tour, whitewater rafting, 1,600+ climbing routes, trail races to a 100-mile ultra and the Arrowhead bike trails. Two new pins (Long Point, Kaymoor Miners); the post is attached to the Endless Wall, park and bridge pins.

reels.title: 4 national parks, 1 epic Colorado road trip
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Four national parks, one epic Colorado road trip (in and out of Denver; allow 10-14 days): Rocky Mountain (Trail Ridge Road, Emerald Lake, Haiyaha, Bear Lake, Sky Pond, Alberta Falls, Sprague Lake, Chasm Lake), Great Sand Dunes (sandboarding, the dunes, Medano Creek), Mesa Verde (Cliff Palace and Balcony House tours, Spruce Tree House, Park Point), Ouray and the San Juans (Million Dollar Highway; Telluride, Ouray, Silverton), Black Canyon of the Gunnison (sunset at Dragon Point, Painted Wall, Cedar Point, Sunset View, Tomichi Point, East Portal Road) and Crested Butte (Snodgrass and Lower Loop wildflower trails). Thirteen new pins added; the post is attached as a source on ten more.

reels.title: Bridge Day at New River Gorge
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.theme: Bridge Day festival, New River Gorge
reels.recommendation_summary: Bridge Day at New River Gorge — 'the craziest thing we've ever seen': on the third Saturday of October the 876-foot bridge closes to traffic and BASE jumpers leap and get catapulted off it, with rappelling, catwalk walks and zip lines, a 5K, food trucks and local art; or watch the jumpers from Fayette Station Road at river level. The bridge is added as a new pin; the post is attached to the park pin.

reels.title: 4 national parks, 1 epic Alaska trip
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Four national parks, one epic Alaska trip (allow at least 10 days): Kenai Fjords (Harding Icefield Trail, wildlife and glacier boat tour), Katmai (fly-in only; Brooks Falls, Valley of Ten Thousand Smokes), Denali (flightseeing, Park Road wildlife, Savage Alpine Trail), Palmer (Knik Glacier paddleboarding, Hatcher Pass hiking), Wrangell-St. Elias (Bagley Icefield flightseeing, Root Glacier, Kennecott Mill) and Valdez ('the cutest fishing town': Thompson Pass, Keystone Canyon, Solomon Gulch Hatchery). Two new pins (Thompson Pass, Keystone Canyon); the post is attached as a source on eleven more.

reels.title: An underrated road trip — Reno, Tahoe, volcanoes and redwoods
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: An underrated road trip — fly in and out of Reno: Lake Tahoe (East Shore Trail, Sand Harbor, Secret Cove, Emerald Bay), Crater Lake (Merriam Point, Garfield Peak, Watchman Peak, Cleetwood Cove), the Redwoods (Avenue of the Giants, Tall Trees Grove, Lady Bird Johnson Grove, Klamath Overlook, Grove of Titans, Fern Canyon) and Lassen Volcanic (Manzanita Lake Loop, Lassen Peak, Cinder Cone, Bumpass Hell, Sulphur Works) — giant trees, volcanic landscapes, clear blue water and hardly any crowds. Ten new pins added; the post is attached as a source on eleven more.

reels.title: East or West USA?
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: An 'East or West USA?' montage — Appalachian sunsets, fall color and lighthouses against Tahoe, redwoods, Yosemite, Bryce, Rainier and the Tetons — from a couple who grew up on the East Coast. No places named; no pins or sources.

reels.title: 54 down, 10 to go
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: A '54 down, 10 to go' photo montage of the couple in 45 national parks, from their first (Arches) onward, promoting their free National Park Checklist. Park-level only; no pins or sources.

reels.title: How to visit Katmai for the bears
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: How to visit Katmai for the bears, their favorite way: snag Brooks Camp camping permits in January/February, fly Anchorage to King Salmon, then float plane to Brooks Camp — camping beats the day-trip crowds because you get the viewing platforms in the quiet hours. Attached as a source on the Katmai and Brooks Falls pins.

reels.title: Rose River Falls in the fall
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Rose River Falls in the fall — 'a National Park hike you NEED to do this fall': 2.5 miles out and back, moderate, 666 feet down (and back up) to a 67-foot waterfall; combine with Dark Hollow Falls for a 5.5-mile loop. Peak Shenandoah foliage is usually mid-to-late October. Attached as a source on the existing pin.

reels.title: One of the most beautiful US road trips — the Pacific Northwest
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: One of the most beautiful US road trips — the Pacific Northwest: Crater Lake (sunrise at Watchman Peak, Garfield Peak, Merriam Point), the Columbia River Gorge (Multnomah Falls, Latourell Falls), Mount Rainier (Fremont Lookout, Burroughs Mountain, Skyline Loop), the Enchantments (Colchuck Lake), North Cascades (Cascade Pass, Sahale Arm, Diablo Lake Vista Point, Maple Pass) and Olympic (Hoh Rainforest, Sol Duc Falls, Hurricane Hill, Mount Storm King, Rialto Beach, Ruby Beach). Four new pins added (both gorge falls, Hurricane Hill, Rialto Beach); the post is attached as a source on fifteen more.

reels.title: America's next national park — Chiricahua
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: America's next national park is here: the Chiricahua National Park Act passed both chambers and was signed into law, making the southeastern Arizona monument the 64th national park — a perfect add-on to a Saguaro trip. Favorite hike: the Echo Canyon Loop; must-see overlook: Massai Point, especially at sunrise or sunset. Two new pins added; the post is attached to the existing park pin.

reels.title: Antigravity drone (sponsored)
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: A sponsored post for the Antigravity A1 360 drone (Follow Me Bundle) — drone footage of the couple on a clifftop at sunset, with no location identified. No pins or sources.

reels.title: Virginia fall foliage — current conditions and tips
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: A Virginia fall road trip with conditions from October 11-14: favorite Shenandoah sunrise overlooks Hazel Mountain, Buck Hollow and Tunnel Parking; hiking notes for Hawksbill Summit (highest point, steep) and Bearfence (rock scramble); the Massanutten scenic chairlift (Fri-Sun 10-4:30), Carter Mountain Orchard (daily 9-6 in October, weekend tickets), Staunton (Reunion Bakery, Zynodoa), the Blue Ridge Parkway (Twenty Minute Cliffs is their all-time favorite overlook here, plus Humpback Rocks) and Lexington. Three new pins added (the sunrise overlooks); the post is attached as a source on six more.

reels.title: Katmai — the national park for bear lovers
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Katmai, 'the national park for bear lovers': brown bears crowd Brooks Falls for the salmon run every summer. Their tips — fly to King Salmon, then float plane or water taxi to Brooks Camp (or day-tour from Anchorage, King Salmon, Homer or Seward); camping permits drop in January/February and the lodge books by lottery ~1.5 years out; best late June-September (July peak); 1-3 days; must-sees Brooks Falls and the Valley of Ten Thousand Smokes; and yes, bear school is mandatory. Attached as a source on all three pins.

reels.title: Illilouette Falls — the most underrated hike in Yosemite
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Illilouette Falls, 'the most underrated hike in Yosemite': via the Panorama Trail from Glacier Point — about 5.3 miles round trip, 1,430 feet of gain, 3-4 hours, moderate — epic waterfall views with almost no one around, unlike Vernal, Nevada and Upper Yosemite Falls. Added as a new pin.

reels.title: High Peaks Trail — a crazy bucket list hike at Pinnacles
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: The High Peaks Trail at Pinnacles, 'California's version of Angels Landing': route options via Condor Gulch, the Balconies Cave loop or Juniper Canyon; steep, exposed, handrail-assisted sections through the spires — rated hard, though they found it more fun than scary. Watch for California condors overhead, and respect the summer heat. Attached as a source on the existing pin.

reels.title: Seward, Alaska — the cutest harbor town
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: An exact repost of their Seward, Alaska reel from earlier in this batch (the cutest harbor town: Kenai Fjords boat tour, SeaLife Center, Ray's or Chinooks, Harding Icefield Trail, fishing charter). Flagged as a repost — no new sources attached.

reels.title: 4 national parks, 1 epic road trip — California
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: An exact repost of their California national parks road trip reel from earlier in this batch (Yosemite, Kings Canyon, Sequoia, Pinnacles, Big Sur). Flagged as a repost — no new sources attached.

reels.title: Antigravity A1 drone (sponsored)
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: A sponsored post for the Antigravity A1 drone — Kelley flies it for the first time on a beach; no location identified. No pins or sources.

reels.title: Seeing Denali from the air
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Seeing Denali from the air with K2 Aviation: Denali is 20,310 feet — taller base-to-peak than Everest — and they call flightseeing the best way to explore the park (code Kelleyandcarl for 10% off). Attached as a source on the existing Denali pin.

reels.title: Congaree — visiting 'one of the worst US national parks'
reels.creator: @kelleyandcarlsadventures
reels.recommendation_summary: Their honest Congaree mini guide — visiting 'one of the worst US national parks': it sits toward the bottom of their 53-park list, but the champion trees and the largest old-growth bottomland hardwood forest in the US earn its status. Walk the Boardwalk Trail and Weston Lake Loop (new pin), or paddle; visit November-March to beat the mosquito meter; go early for the light; expect flooded trails. The post is attached to the park and boardwalk pins.

reels.title: Colchuck Lake — all other hikes are ruined

reels.title: Sahale Arm — worth every single step
reels.creator: @morgan_smile
reels.recommendation_summary: A photo carousel from Sahale Arm in North Cascades National Park (tagged location: Cascade Pass/Sahale Arm). 'Some places are worth every single step... I love a good physical challenge, but it's the mental reset that keeps me coming back to the mountains.' Attached as a source on the existing Sahale Arm Trail pin; no new pin.

reels.title: Mooney Falls — the hike that ruined all other hikes
reels.creator: @stumblinguponserendipity
reels.recommendation_summary: A single-place reel: Mooney Falls at the Havasupai Reservation, Arizona — 'unfortunately this hike ruined all other hikes for me.' Notes the $455 backpacking permit (sells out months in advance) and the chains-and-ladders descent to the base of the falls. Attached as a source on the existing Mooney Falls pin; no new pin.

reels.title: Lake Superior winter bucket list
reels.creator: @maddymarq
reels.recommendation_summary: Her personal Lake Superior winter bucket list — three things she plans every year: (1) sunrise at Artist Point in Grand Marais, Minnesota, over the frozen lake at 20 below zero or colder; (2) the Apostle Islands ice caves — kayak the mainland sea caves in summer, or walk across the frozen lake when the Park Service opens foot access; (3) Michigan's Keweenaw Peninsula for skiing, frozen waterfalls and sauna. All three are new pins (places identified from the reel's narration; the caption itself names no places).

reels.title: 57 parks down — our favorite parks, by category
reels.creator: @katieandjoeonthego
reels.creator_name: Katie And Joe | Adventure Travel Couple
reels.theme: Favorite national parks by category (57 parks visited)
reels.recommendation_summary: Katie & Joe — 57 of the 64 US national parks visited, 7 left — award 23 parks their own titles instead of picking one favorite: Mount Rainier (hiking), Capitol Reef (snacks), Carlsbad Caverns (otherworldly vibes), Olympic (camping), White Sands (sunsets), Acadia (sunrise), Bryce Canyon (stargazing), Yosemite (waterfalls), Great Smoky Mountains (fall foliage), Katmai (wildlife), Gates of the Arctic (feel small), Lake Clark (solitude), Isle Royale (backpacking), Kenai Fjords (unique experiences), Dry Tortugas (history), Death Valley (backcountry driving), Glacier (take your breath away), Wind Cave (evening program), Theodore Roosevelt (scenic drive), Gateway Arch (visitor center experience), Arches (only one day), Grand Canyon (don't want to hike), Badlands (fossils). Sources attach to the 22 existing park pins; Gateway Arch National Park is a new pin (the dataset's first for that park).

reels.title: Newspaper Rock petroglyphs — Bears Ears
reels.creator: @christiandelatorre_
reels.recommendation_summary: Christian de la Torre at Newspaper Rock, Utah — panning shots of the famous petroglyph panel in Indian Creek Canyon (Bears Ears National Monument): 650+ carvings (figures, animals, footprints, handprints, spirals) spanning ~2,000 years, viewed from behind a railing at a roadside pullout on UT-211. 'I just can't get over these petroglyphs — history is so fascinating.' One new pin.

reels.title: Battery Spencer — best Golden Gate view
reels.creator: @thisworldofadventure
reels.theme: Battery Spencer / Golden Gate Bridge viewpoint
reels.recommendation_summary: Courtney & Matt's bucket-list Golden Gate viewpoint: Battery Spencer, the historic gun battery high above the bridge on the Marin Headlands (Sausalito side). Quick stop, huge payoff — views of the bridge, San Francisco and the bay. Go about an hour before sunset and stay through it; the colors keep improving. Fog can roll in fast and wipe the view. One new pin.

reels.title: God's Thumb via the Knoll — Lincoln City
reels.creator: @littleredtravels
reels.recommendation_summary: Emily's (@littleredtravels) hike guide to God's Thumb via the Knoll Trail, Lincoln City, Oregon: 4 miles, 987 ft gain, 600 ft of it in the first mile ('a staircase to heaven'), through The Knoll meadow to the basalt headland above the Pacific. Dog friendly, no restrooms, street parking; don't take the cul-de-sac trail — the trail starts on the left. One new pin.

reels.title: Chicago's first self-cleaning public toilet
reels.creator: @se.kwon
reels.theme: Chicago first — self-cleaning public toilet at the Polish Triangle
reels.recommendation_summary: A tour of Chicago's first self-cleaning public toilet — the new JCDecaux automated restroom at the Polish Triangle in Wicker Park/West Town, opened Nov 11, 2026: free, ADA-compliant, 15-minute limit, and the bowl self-disinfects with high-pressure jets between uses.

reels.title: Part 2 of Free 10/10 Viewpoints in San Francisco
reels.creator: @dhillon.diary
reels.theme: Free 10/10 viewpoints in San Francisco — Part 2
reels.recommendation_summary: Part 2 of her free 10/10 San Francisco viewpoints, in order: Pier 7 at dusk, Crissy Field Beach at golden hour, Alta Plaza Park, and the Lands End hike — all free, all for friends or a solo clear-your-mind visit.

reels.title: Grosse Point Lighthouse | Evanston, Illinois
reels.creator: @icynthiareds
reels.recommendation_summary: A visual tour of the Grosse Point Lighthouse in Evanston — a historic 1873 lighthouse on the Lake Michigan shore, about 30 minutes from downtown Chicago, one of the prettiest and most historic corners of Evanston and worth adding to a Chicago-area visit list.

reels.title: 3 BEST SPOTS FOR SUNSET IN DOOR COUNTY
reels.creator: @officetooutdoorsblog
reels.recommendation_summary: Three sunset spots in Door County, Wisconsin, ranked: Ellison Bluff County Park in Ellison Bay (cliffside overlook above Green Bay), Sunset Beach Park in Fish Creek (sun straight into the bay from a rocky shore and grassy bluff), and Pebble Beach in Sister Bay (a quiet, secluded pebble shoreline).

reels.title: Experience one of Acadia's hidden gems!
reels.creator: @ryan.goes.hiking
reels.recommendation_summary: Penobscot Mountain Trail in Acadia National Park — a hidden gem across Jordan Pond from the Bubbles hikes, 2.9 miles out-and-back with 980 feet of gain to a ~1,200-foot summit with 360-degree views of the pond, mountains and Atlantic; rated hard on AllTrails.
